name: OfficeCLI Data Dashboard
summary: Multi-element Excel dashboards from CSV or tabular input: Dashboard sheet on open, formula-driven KPI cards, charts, sparklines and conditional formatting. OpenRA-adapted carry of the iOfficeAI/AionCore skill: the install section is replaced by a prerequisite check (officecli must already be installed via OpenRA's approved CLI path; the skill only verifies officecli --version) and an Apache-2.0 §4(b) modification notice is added; everything else is upstream text.

summaryI18n.zh-CN: 从 CSV 或表格输入生成多元素 Excel 仪表盘：打开即见 Dashboard 工作表、公式驱动的 KPI 卡片、图表、迷你图与条件格式。OpenRA 对 iOfficeAI/AionCore 技能的适配版：安装段替换为前置条件检查（officecli 须已经由 OpenRA 批准的 CLI 路径安装，技能只验证 officecli --version），并加 Apache-2.0 §4(b) 修改注记，其余为上游原文。
